copy.overview_subtitle: Enterprise behavior analytics over a Tau2 airline benchmark snapshot.

frame.thesis: Persona and emotion activations provide a first-layer behavioral surface over product interactions.
frame.constraint: These reads are directional triage signals, not reward predictors. Session-level interpretation lives in the session drilldown.

persona_overview.normalization_note: Segment z-deltas use frozen per-run global mean/sd over raw direction-oriented values. Min-max normalized values are presentation-only.

simulated_trace_series.frame: Example-only deployment preview storyboard. Each 20-session block is sorted from Tau2 task labels; block boundaries are sorting artifacts, not observed drift.

methodology_notes: Task labels come from the active provider normalization layer.
Final action labels come from the active provider normalization layer.
Displayed z-deltas are computed from raw direction-oriented projections against the current run's global basis.
Min-max normalized trait-intensity scores are used only for compact visual fills and the example storyboard.
The deployment preview storyboard uses synthetic task-mode segments, not real deployment time.
Outlier score is root-mean-square z-score across selected persona and emotion-cluster vectors within the trace workflow.
Outlier turn charts compare each assistant turn with traces in a similar length bucket and relative turn-position bucket.
High-stakes probes stay on the Overview page; product analytics focuses on persona, emotion, workflow, and action baselines.
